newsitem.title: GERMANY: Normal hours for the German bourse on Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: Normal hours for the German bourse on Dec 30.

text.p: Floor trade in German stocks on the last trading day of the year, December 30, will last from 0930 GMT until 1230 GMT as usual, the German bourse said on Tuesday.
But electronic IBIS dealings in shares and the German futures bourse (DTB) will close at 1300 GMT, earlier than the usual 1600 GMT.
Meanwhile, the bourse said the last foreign exchange dealings of the year would start at 0945 GMT and the last gold exchange at 0915 GMT.
